description: Cross-platform SDK for the Sendspin synchronized multi-room audio protocol. Connect to Music Assistant servers and play synchronized audio across multiple devices.
releaseNotes:
v10.1.0 - Source role reporting through SendspinHostService

Additive; no breaking changes from 10.0.0.
- SendspinHostService.SetSourceSignalAsync(bool) reports the source line-sense signal for a
  server-initiated app. The value is applied to every open connection and remembered, so
  each new connection carries it in its initial client/state.
- SendspinHostService.SourceRoleStateChanged (SourceRoleState: ServerId, IsActive,
  TrustLevel) is raised when a connection is admitted and on every later server/activate,
  so the app can see whether its source role is active and at what trust.

v10.0.0 - Encrypted transport, Sendspin spec 1.0.0-rc1 (BREAKING)

Implements Sendspin/spec at tag 1.0.0-rc1 (671a34d). Requires aiosendspin 10.0.0 or later,
the first release of that spec; Music Assistant ships the 10.x line. There is no downgrade
negotiation: use the 9.x line for an older server.

Transport and identity
- Every connection is encrypted end to end (Noise KKpsk2). Plaintext is gone.
- Clients have a persistent Curve25519 identity. SendspinClientOptions.Identity is required;
  build it with SendspinIdentity.FromStore(store), NOT Generate(), or the client gets a new
  client_id every launch and silently loses every pairing on restart.
- Construction moved to SendspinClientService.CreateForDial(loggerFactory, options) with a
  SendspinClientOptions object.
- Neither connection teardown path waits for the peer's Close frame any longer, so an app
  exit can no longer hang against a peer that never answers.

Pairing
- Pairing PSK plus at most one optional pairing-code method, dynamic or static (CPace):
  dynamic_pairing_code / static_pairing_code, fixed 6- and 8-digit codes. Pairing
  configuration is local and set through ClientCapabilities; no server can change it.
- Gesture-gated attempts (every static code attempt, and a dynamic one once held back)
  need a PairingWindow opened by a deliberate operator gesture. Without one pairing never
  completes, and nothing throws.
- A mistyped dynamic pairing code is retried in place (client/pair-retry), so
  PresentPairingCodeAsync can run more than once for one attempt.
- IPairingRecordStore.Upsert returns void and stores declare a Capacity; the SDK evicts the
  least recently used record itself. Records carry ServerId and LastUsedUtc; 9.x record
  files still load. server/unpair removes that server's record.

Protocol
- client/state reports 'available' as a boolean, carries the full state of every role
  object it includes, and includes an object only for an active role.
- stream/request-format is removed. RequestPlayerFormatAsync, RequestArtworkFormatAsync and
  RequestVisualizerFormatAsync become SetPlayerFormatPreferenceAsync, SetArtworkChannelAsync
  and SetVisualizerConfigurationAsync. ArtworkChannelSpec is ArtworkChannelState;
  ClientCapabilities.VisualizerSupport is VisualizerRoleSupport.
- "Static delay" is "output delay" on the C# surface and the wire (output_delay_ms,
  set_output_delay), clamped to 0-5000 with no alias for the old names.
- client/hello no longer carries trust_level, player supported_commands or
  artwork@v1_support.
- Artwork arrives as an announce/part/cancel transfer. ArtworkReceived and ArtworkCleared are
  unchanged; BinaryMessageParser.ParseArtworkChunk is replaced by TryParseArtwork.
- Controller commands are sent only while controller@v1 is active and the group lists the
  command in supported_commands; otherwise they are dropped with a warning.
- server/activate follows the rc1 activity table: playback keeps running during a pairing
  attempt, active roles persist across a re-handshake, and a removed stream role is stopped
  without a stream/end.
- ClientCapabilities values the spec does not allow now throw ArgumentException at
  construction: a player with no flac or pcm format, a visualizer BufferCapacity or RateMax
  that is not positive, an invalid artwork channel, a MacAddress that is not lowercase
  colon-separated.
- New source@v1 role for line-in and microphone capture, on paired connections, or on unpaired
  ones when UnpairedAccessEnabled is on and the server's operator has approved the role.
- ConnectionMode.Auto is removed. A persisted "Auto" no longer parses and the remaining
  ordinals shift.

Audio
- Sync correction follows the spec: a 100 us dead band, continuous correction capped at
  0.5%, and a one-shot snap above 5 ms. TimedAudioBuffer.Read applies all of it and is the
  default path again; SyncCorrectedSampleSource does the same through a built-in resampler.
- buffer_capacity is derived from ClientCapabilities.AudioBufferCapacityMs instead of a flat
  32 MB. Give TimedAudioBuffer the same number.
- Clock synchronization matches the reference implementation, and a player announces
  itself about two seconds after connecting.
- An in-place stream/start that changes sample rate or channel count keeps the buffered
  audio: AudioPipeline plays it out before re-opening the output for the new format.
- IAudioPipeline.StartAsync returns an AudioPipelineStartOutcome; IClockSynchronizer and
  ISendspinConnection each gain one member. Only custom implementations are affected.

Migration guide (every breaking change, with before/after code):
https://github.com/Sendspin/sendspin-dotnet/blob/main/src/Sendspin.SDK/MIGRATION-10.0.0.md

Spec pin, compatibility floor and known deviations:
https://github.com/Sendspin/sendspin-dotnet/blob/main/docs/SPEC-VERSION.md

Earlier release notes: https://github.com/Sendspin/sendspin-dotnet/releases
